scientific_integrity: Classical geometry acknowledged; finite numerical checks not substituted for proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independent equiaffine/eccentric-anomaly sampling of a noncircular ellipse. The 1959 circumcenter identity and SU(4) astroid trace support are known; newly assessed is the induced random law, moments, cusp scaling and conditional limit. Density is defined a.e., cusp statement is asymptotic; novelty is best-knowledge and not independently verified.
source_ids: American Mathematical Monthly 66 (1959) 62, E1348, Klamkin-Miller/Sister Mary Stephanie
title: The universal astroid law and sharp cusp scaling of random ellipse circumcenters
